references.text: Jericho is first mentioned when the spies were sent there, and Rahab hid them.
Rahab explains that the inhabitants of Jericho feared the Israelites, which accounts for why the city was shut up.
Moses prophesied that the peoples of Canaan would fear Israel when they heard about the Lord's deeds.
The Lord promised to put terror and dread of Israel upon all the people in the land.
Moses' song prophesied that the peoples of Canaan would tremble with fear when they heard about Israel.
The kings of the Amorites and Canaanites lost heart when they heard about the crossing of the Jordan.
Hebrews mentions that the walls of Jericho fell by faith after the Israelites had marched around the city for seven days.
